name: GlobalDelete
caption: When a record is deleted

configuration.description: Table whose deletions start the flow. Stored on the trigger registration at publish; 0 means the flow never fires.

Field filters the deleted record must match: [{ "fieldNo": <integer>, "filter": "<BC filter expression>" }]. Applied literally (max 250 chars, placeholders not resolved). Rows with fieldNo 0 are skipped; duplicate fieldNo: last wins.

Fields of the deleted record to expose as value outputs: [{ "fieldNo": <integer>, "name": "<output name, max 30>" }]. The editor auto-fills name from the field caption (PascalCase, umlauts transliterated). See notes: at run time the value is emitted under the table field's own name, not under 'name'.

outputs.name: <outputFields[].name>
outputs.when: one per outputFields entry with fieldNo <> 0 (only when tableNo > 0); name = entry.name, or the table field's name when entry.name is empty

rules.check: configuration.tableNo must be present and > 0 (editor ValidateConfiguration returns false otherwise). Not checked at publish.
configuration.filters, if present, must be an array.
configuration.outputFields, if present, must be an array.
An invalid filter expression makes the record count as not matching; the user's delete is never blocked.

notes: There is no Rec reference output: the record no longer exists when the flow runs. Only the fields listed in outputFields are carried, as locale-invariant (XML-format) text.

KNOWN DISCREPANCY: the declared output name is outputFields[].name (editor default: PascalCase of the caption, e.g. 'No' for 'No.'), but at run time the value is stored under the table field's own name (e.g. 'No.', 'Credit Limit (LCY)', truncated to 30). When the two differ, a reference to the declared name does not receive the value. Until this is resolved, set name equal to the table field's name, or verify with a test run. Field names containing spaces or dots may not be usable in {{slug_name}} references at all.

Execution is asynchronous: the delete creates a pending execution in the deleting transaction; a recurring Job Queue entry (every 5 minutes, created on publish) queues one Job Queue run per pending execution. Runs commit after every step.
Step-level rule imposed by this trigger: a Confirm dialog step gets the publish warning that it runs inside the record change that started the flow.
Picker filters: Respond to Webhook, Return SubFlow Output, Return PDF, Set report file name, Set document field values and Prevent page close are hidden.
